Title: Application Insights is available in Central India and Canada Central

Body.Content: Azure Application Insights is now available in Central India and Canada Central. Application Insights can monitor applications in any part of the world, and Application Insights resources can be created in seven regions. Collected data is stored locally in the selected region.
